reason: Eligible facts are visible: user id and reservation id were obtained, the cancellation reason is change of plan, no portion of the trip has been flown, booking was made on 2024-05-01 (within 24 hours of the 2024-05-15 policy time is false, so that criterion does not apply), but the reservation is in economy and has no insurance.
